title: ClawdBot connects your local computer to WhatsApp or iMessage

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: If your timeline is full of people talking about a lobster named Claude, here's what's going on. Claudebot connects your local computer to WhatsApp or iMessage. Instead of opening a browser, you just text your server, "Hey, did I pay that bill?" or "Summarize this PDF." Because it stores everything in local markdown files, it actually remembers who you are and what you did last week. private, free, and it finally makes AI feel like a friend in your contacts instead of a
